name: trace2fix
description: A proof of concept that turns a deployed-image vulnerability into an attributable remediation plan.

scripts.check: node --check bin/trace2fix.js && node --check src/cli.js && node --check src/cosign.js && node --check src/input.js && node --check src/plan.js && node --check src/tools.js && node --check src/trivy.js
scripts.demo: node bin/trace2fix.js analyze --workload examples/deployment.json --trivy examples/trivy.json --provenance examples/provenance.json --cve CVE-2026-0001
